title: Leonida Trophy Guide
about: All 55 trophies with their official names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them. The guide under each trophy is written for this entry and names its sources; a source is cited beside the trophy, never copied. 28 trophies are hidden on PlayStation until earned, including every story trophy. There are no online trophies. One trophy can be missed: Positive Mental Attitude. Expect roughly 200 hours for the platinum.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself. There is nothing separate to do for it: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. The roadmap in this guide is the order that gets there in a single playthrough of roughly 200 hours, so work the stages in order and this one closes the list.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy for finishing the mission Gone Fishing. It cannot be missed: play the campaign and it unlocks as the mission ends. Like every story trophy it stays hidden on PlayStation until it pops.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. Before you let the chapter close, do the one missable thing in this whole list: Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house (see Positive Mental Attitude). Park a manual save at the chapter's start too — there is no mission replay, so a chapter save is your only way back.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. This chapter quietly unlocks half the list: switching between Jason and Lucia opens just after the Breakfast Run mission, the garage app arrives with Daily Driver, the Scooter Bros app with Moses, and Kingpin Bowling can be robbed. Start those threads as they appear.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Jewelry robberies open during this chapter (see Sneakthief), and the time-sensitive Race Against Yago appears here — run it the moment it shows instead of leaving it for later.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Near the end of the chapter the optional mission That's Where The Money Is opens the bank vaults, so the vault trophies can be started before the finale rather than after it.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission — the gold story trophy. Keep one untouched manual save from just before it. With no mission replay and no New Game Plus, that save is your only route back if anything is still outstanding afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Breakfast Run. It matters beyond the trophy: switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, and every partner trophy in the list needs the two of them together.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission The Cartel Heist. A story trophy, so it unlocks simply by playing through the campaign; chapter trophies sometimes pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the final cutscene.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Child's Play. Unmissable on a normal playthrough of the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Headliners. Unmissable on a normal playthrough of the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission VCIA Takedown. Unmissable on a normal playthrough of the story. The airport it is named after matters again later, for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on a normal playthrough of the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion — the second gold and the longest job on the list. The checklist only appears after the story, under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but everything you do earlier still counts. Its targets run past the matching trophies: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 Challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicles, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and 15 card sets. Most of the roughly 200 hours to the platinum is spent here.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total. The 100% checklist wants 300, so treat 250 as a waypoint and keep going rather than stopping at the trophy.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of activity at least once. The types surface as you roam — races, fishing, arcade games, hunting, meditation and the rest — so sample anything new the map offers and this unlocks along the way instead of needing a session of its own.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds spread across the game's two ranges. Learn one range's targets at a time and replay a challenge until its gold score feels routine before moving on.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in all. One win per location is enough, so move on as soon as a location is ticked off instead of defending a streak.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same event do not add to the count, so keep entering new races around the state rather than farming one favourite circuit.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. It is available early — a launch-week checklist knocks it out in Chapter 1 — so take Cal on as soon as the challenge is offered rather than saving it for the cleanup.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. There are four in-game arcade games and any of them counts, so pick the one you enjoy and finish it — another trophy a launch-week checklist clears in Chapter 1.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's strand of side missions. Andy's questline is Lucia-only, and like the other side-story finales it stays available after the credits, so it is safe to leave for the cleanup pass. Note it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — that trophy tracks other strands.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand of side missions. The finale stays available after the story ends, so there is no rush to close it mid-campaign.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's strand of side missions. It stays open after the credits. Billy's strand has this trophy of its own and does not add to Strangers & Freaks, so do not expect the counter there to move when it ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. Not every strand counts — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have trophies of their own and do not add to this one — so check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. One warning: Race Against Yago, a Chapter 3 race inside Yago's strand, is time-sensitive (it carries an hourglass icon), so run it the moment it appears.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's strand of side missions. The finale stays available after the credits, so it is safe cleanup work whenever you get to it.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's strand of side missions. Tyrone's questline is Jason-only, and his strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it closes with this trophy instead.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and an outdoor spot counts for both characters if your partner meditates with you. The missable one is in Chapter 1: on a morning after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia steps onto the balcony of Jason's house to meditate. Follow her and accept the task — that spot disappears when Chapter 1 ends, and it is not confirmed whether the trophy strictly needs it. Keep a Chapter 1 save until this pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and works through target decks that send you after specific animals; a clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine. The questline stays available after the credits.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered all over Leonida, so pick up every one you pass from the start. The 100% checklist eventually asks for 15 sets, far past this trophy, so early collecting pays off twice.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Make a habit of it as you travel between jobs — the same app scans vehicles toward Whip It Good, so the two grinds feed each other if you use it constantly.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges, tracked under Progress > Challenges. There are 80 in total, in eight categories of ten, and many complete on their own as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this trophy is a waypoint rather than the end of the grind.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. The easy way is a bank vault job, which hands you 4 stars the moment you leave: escape together and the trophy pops once you are clear of the red heat zone, not merely out of the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level in between. Call your partner first, then chain the three robberies while the police are still on you — if the stars fade and only the red heat zone remains, the chain breaks. Give it a moment afterwards: the trophy can take about 30 seconds to pop after the third shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive rather than waiting to own each model. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so keep scanning long after this pops.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 achievements

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus, the slow-motion aim you trigger with L3 + R3 while aiming. Line the group up first — the guards at a gang's illegal operation work well — use an assault rifle, and let adrenaline stretch the Focus window.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The jets at gates E3 and E4 work. Save first, because the police come fast, then take off and fly about a kilometre away; the trophy pops late.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The hint — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — means getting into a military tank. Tanks are parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, climb in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens these robberies: use the Snap Gun on the locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm — then find the note with the safe code in the back room, open the safe and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; if you are spotted, reload rather than pushing on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.target: 5 bank vaults (the 100% checklist asks for all 8)
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. Bring your partner — the bags are too much to carry alone — and expect a 4-star Wanted Level the moment you leave, which is also your Hot Together opportunity. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. As with the other robbery trophies, it pops only once you have left the red heat zone entirely, so keep driving until you are fully clear rather than just out of sight.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. This is a coverage trophy: it fills in as you roam the whole state for the other grinds, so leave it to the cleanup pass and check which corners of the map are still dark.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs — one operation per gang is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so if you clear operations as you find them, this pops on the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The official hint is all anyone has: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Have the drink when you are passing and do not build your route around it — it may simply pop during normal play. This guide will not invent steps the sources do not confirm.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The only hint is the description itself: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Until a trigger is confirmed, treat any showroom escape as a maybe and move on — no source confirms the exact conditions yet.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates bowling alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs. Take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. Leave something behind and the operation comes back later, so this one is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Hidden, with a cryptic hint — but there is a reported reading of it: it should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner present, because the partner trains alongside you and both stat lines climb together.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Fill it with 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed the counter, so over a normal playthrough it completes on its own rather than needing a grind of its own — check on it during the cleanup, not before.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. 'Second time's the charm' is the only hint any source has, which suggests a retry of something — but nothing confirms what, so this guide will not guess. If it pops, it will most likely be while you are repeating an attempt at something else.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The description — 'What the hell just happened?' — is the whole hint, and no source confirms a trigger. Leave this one to chance during normal play; it is one of five hidden trophies still waiting for a confirmed method.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed method at launch. The hint reads 'Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by', which on its face suggests knocking people down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — but no source confirms the exact trigger yet, so treat that reading as a guess, not a method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them on to your contacts and the total accumulates across the whole playthrough, so it lands naturally if you keep fencing what the robberies bring in.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, and the garages and vehicle registrations you buy for other trophies do most of the work — check what is left during the cleanup rather than spending for its own sake.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties: the eight garages sold in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, for about $160,000 in total. Garages the story hands you do not count. Buy them early — every vehicle you register needs a free garage space.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register at a Pay 'n' Spray with a standard tracker. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
